events.title: November Update - Quality Of Life
events.summary: Loot containers now have a sort button.Backpack has a Move stacks button to automatically move items to containers.Backpack has a Move class button to automatically move items of a similar class{for example if you have a box with seeds and use the move class button, any seeds in your inventory will move into the box}More things can now be dismantled on a workbench.Block damage for building materials shown in more places.Recipe button added where appropriate.Fix issue with Fire goblin drops.Rebal

events.title: Major update September 2026
events.summary: Revamp of the materials upgrading system, Now there are mallets for each core material up to polished steel. Using these mallets you can upgrade any lesser block to that mallets level as long as you have the materials. So change a stone house to Iron by holding the iron mallet and having iron in your inventory.Added fishing + fish in seas and rivers. More meals added using fish / Additional buffs added.Added dragon missions + they will appear later in the game anyway.On the Quit screen the game

events.title: 15 August 2026 Various issues fixed and new features.
events.summary: NPC icons on the task screen show a graph of the like state.Added as Ethereal Sieve, Store items in this container and they will automatically be sorted into nearby containers based on the contents of those containers, Firstly by matching items and then by category, This is a mid game item as it requires an upgraded cauldron to make.Big bug fix on the internal math for buff effects being scaled incorrectly, Hot/Cold and Bleeding no longer stop you in your tracks, the effect is more subtle.Fixed
